import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the CSV file into a DataFrame
weather_df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Calculate the average rainfall per city
average_rainfall_per_city = weather_df.groupby('city')['precip_mm'].mean()

# Plot the average rainfall per city as a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
average_rainfall_per_city.plot(kind='bar', color='skyblue')
plt.title('Average Rainfall per City')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Average Rainfall (mm)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
